channel.title: Business Insider Africa - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider Africa (africa.businessinsider.com)

item.title: China's lithium price soars after Zimbabwe export ban
item.description: Lithium prices and stocks jumped after Zimbabwe, a leading global producer, suspended exports of lithium concentrate, sparking concerns about tightening global supplies of the critical battery material.

item.title: Egyptian Tycoon Hisham Talaat Moustafa seals deal with Hong Kong hotel giant to manage two historic Nile hotels
item.description: Egyptian tycoon Hisham Talaat Moustafa has sealed a deal with Hong Kong–based Mandarin Oriental to manage two of Egypt’s most historic Nile-side hotels, marking a fresh push into Africa’s fast-growing luxury tourism market.

item.title: Despite the hardship, African youths are the most mentally stable in the world
item.description: Wealth isn't necessarily a benefit when it comes to mental health, a new report released in February shows, and nowhere is this more evident than in Africa.

item.title: Zambia joins the list of African countries rejecting the U.S. “strings-attached” health funds
item.description: Zambia has halted a proposed health funding agreement worth more than $1 billion from the United States, citing concerns that certain clauses in the draft do not fit with the country's national interests.

item.title: Rwanda and 2 other African countries received $32m from US in deportation deals, senate report says
item.description: The United States has expanded the use of third-country deportations to several African countries, a policy shift that is drawing scrutiny over its financial cost and oversight mechanisms, according to a report by Democrats on the Senate Foreign Relations Committee.

item.title: UK bank records $10m loss on Cameroon, Gambia divestment
item.description: UK-based lender Standard Chartered has reported a $10m loss following its divestment from operations in Cameroon and The Gambia, even as the bank posted strong global earnings for 2025.

item.title: Africa's e-commerce giant targets spending rebound to knock off Chinese rivals
item.description: Africa’s leading online retailer, Jumia, is positioning itself to capitalize on renewed consumer spending in Nigeria, unveiling an ambitious growth campaign to deepen the country’s adoption of digital commerce amid rising competition from global rivals.

item.title: Europe’s development bank invests €3.1bn in Africa in 2025, boosting SMEs, clean energy and vaccines
item.description: The European Investment Bank Group has delivered one of its strongest years yet on the continent, deploying €3.1 billion to Africa in 2025 as part of a wider €9 billion package channelled through its development arm, EIB Global.

item.title: World's largest producer of premium aluminium posts annual profit despite $765m Guinea setback
item.description: The world’s largest premium aluminium producer, Emirates Global Aluminium, reported stronger core earnings for 2025 after record metal sales offset a major financial hit tied to its Guinea operations.

item.title: Kenya fines GT Bank for misleading conduct in ASL dispute
item.description: The Competition Authority of Kenya has imposed a substantial penalty on Guaranty Trust Bank Kenya Limited after finding the lender culpable of misleading representation and engaging in unfair business practices against its long-standing client, ASL Limited.
